scope.captureBoundary: Core/environment locator includes padded field frame, floating labels, support and focus contours. Real200% PNGs are1280x813 physical current viewport; CSS viewport640x406. Inventory is1280x720 default viewport.

conclusions: Every one of186 original PNGs was opened separately at original detail, including repeated hashes, and linked to the exact native browser, worker and candidate inputs attachment.

Chromium full declared MD3 size/state images retain complete floating labels/notches, field emphasis, clear icon contours and support/error text in both modes. Actual clear produces empty fields with retained focus and hidden clear button.

Firefox/WebKit medium default/focus/error/clear images retain complete Chinese/Latin glyphs, labels and supports. Native select rendering and scene heights differ visibly by engine; each keeps an independent pixel candidate.

Readonly matrix image scope is Chromium only. Its empty readonly state is visible and native readonly assertions pass; visible default inventory elsewhere does not establish full readonly interaction acceptance.

Long values show only the native input's visible fragment. Original Home/End/Select-all, complete retained value and real scroll displacement prove reachability separately; screenshots do not imply the full value is visible.

Touch images keep the enlarged clear focus contour aligned; actual tap/coarse-pointer/48px assertions remain engineering evidence. RTL/English/brand/system forced-colors/reduced-motion are limited to the captured Chromium environment.

Four MD3 real200% PNGs have complete visible fields/labels/supports and clear focus rings without the earlier caret stripes. Their1280x813 physical viewport is distinct from the640x406 CSS viewport and not a full-page screenshot.

No continuous-animation scene is accepted as a static image. LineEdit has no loading animation protocol in this spec; finite transitions settle naturally. Eligibility means scoped static candidate consideration, never baseline creation or demonstrated two-run stability.
All three configuration-preservation tests passed natively with no PNG. They are recorded as engineering evidence and baseline-ineligible, not manually approved static frames.
No new visible defect found within this assigned MD3 official Linux candidate scope.
